chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Salt, from Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from Yunus, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Muhammad al-Halbi, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
about the Statement of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its death.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Justice after oppression.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Allah gives life to the earth after its death' in Shia interpretation?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) offers a profound allegorical interpretation (tafsir) of Surah Al-Hadid 57:17, linking the physical resurrection of the earth to the spiritual and social resurrection of humanity through the establishment of justice. This exegesis highlights a core Shia theological principle that divine governance restores balance by replacing tyranny (jawr) with equity (adl), serving as both a promise of divine mercy and a mandate for societal reform.
